title: Marine Lodge Liversedge Quantico
intro: Marine Lodge Quantico Liversedge is your TAD/TDY destination! The facility has 66 standard rooms, 50 suites, as well as meeting space to accommodate up to 80 people. The hotel requires a valid credit or debit card at check-in.

sections.heading: Check-in
sections.markdown: Please check-in at Inns of the Corps Quantico, located at 3018 Russell Rd, Quantico, VA 22134.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.markdown:
Military: Active Duty, National Guard, Reserves and Retirees on Leave or Official Duty

DoD Civilians

Valid Credentials REQUIRED at check-in.

sections.heading: Reservations
sections.markdown:
TAD/TDY can book 90 days in advance.

Leisure Reservations can only be made 30 days in advance.

For groups, please email [LodgingReservations.Liversedge@usmc-mccs.org](mailto:LodgingReservations.Liversedge@usmc-mccs.org)

Due to high occupancy, we recommend making reservations as early as possible per the restrictions above.
